inlines.v: TIP'PLE, verb intransitive To drink spiritus or strong liquors habitually; to indulge in the frequent and improper use of spiritus liquors. When a man begins to tipple let his creditors secure their debts. TIP'PLE, verb transitive To drink, as strong liquors, in luxury or excess. --Himself for saving charges. A peel'd, slic'd onion eats, and tipples verjuice. TIP'PLE, noun Drink; liquor taken in tippling.
